recent.text: #Magic coach Sean Sweeney also didn't have a timeline to share when I asked about Izaiyah Nelson, who is 4 months removed from a fractured left ankle. "He's progressing, doing some on-court stuff here, a little bit at a time," Sweeney said. He added the work is "just minimal."
recent.author: Jason Beede
recent.quoted_text: #Magic coach Sean Sweeney said Paolo Banchero (right high ankle sprain) is progressing but “no timeline right now.” Although we didn’t see Banchero on the court during the media-viewing session of shootaround, Sweeney said Banchero is doing well and in good spirits today.

recent.text: The #Magic still must close this out. Franz with back-to-back turnovers. Lucky Pritchard missed that three. Confidence is flowing, but this team is still learning how to win big after all this time. Desmond Bane has been huge in this fourth quarter. ORL 110:103 BOS 0:40 4th
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Both teams' offenses have come alive throughout the fourth quarter. Both teams have figured out how to attack the other's defense. Some big shots from Bane and da Silva. Going to need Franz to close this. #Magic take their use-it-or-lose-it timeout. ORL 104:99 BOS 3:16 4th
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Been a lot of players for the #Magic who are passing up good looks and letting the #Celtics' defense catch up. That last possession should have been a Tristan da Silva three. Passed it up and got a weird Carter floater. ORL 73:74 BOS 0:52 3rd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Back-to-back threes for Jalen Suggs. 👀 Looks like seeing one go in has brought back some confidence. Didn't even hate his technical (helped Tatum missed the free throw). ORL 60:54 BOS 7:20 3rd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Entering today's game, 10 of Bitadze's 23 field goal attempts were alley-oops. He had 41 total alley-oop attempts last year. Carter entered today's game with 13. He had 32 total attempts last year. This is a thing.
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily
recent.quoted_text: Jayson Tatum made an incredible pass after George beat Suggs backdoor. Jalen Suggs came out of nowhere to block the shot after Goga Bitadze forced George to come back to his right. #Magic lead the #Celtics 50-41 at the half.
